title: Linear Recurrent Memory Suffices to Distil a World-Model Policy for Robot Air Hockey
abstract: arXiv:2609.39151v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Does memory-dependent control need nonlinear recurrent dynamics? We study simulated air-hockey defence under temporary loss of puck tracking. A DreamerV3 teacher outperforms a memoryless policy under tracking loss, while resetting the teacher's recurrent state sharply reduces performance, which demonstrates that the task requires memory. We distil this teacher into compact recurrent policies with a 64 dimensional state, with a combination of a diagonal linear recurrence and an optional rank-$k$ nonlinear innovation while retaining nonlinear observation encoders and action heads. Across five matched seeds, the purely linear recurrent model ($k=0$) matches both the GRU baseline and the teacher throughout the tested range of tracking loss. Increasing nonlinear innovation rank providing no measured benefits. This result is obtained on a fresh test split, which will be only opened after all models and analyses are frozen. translated_title: 线性循环记忆足以蒸馏出机器人空气曲棍球的世界模型策略
translated_abstract: 依赖记忆的控制是否需要非线性循环动力学？我们研究了冰球跟踪暂时丢失情况下的仿真空气曲棍球防守任务。DreamerV3教师策略在跟踪丢失的情况下优于无记忆策略，而重置教师的循环状态会显著降低其性能，这证明了该任务需要记忆能力。我们将该教师策略蒸馏为具有64维状态的紧凑循环策略，其采用对角线性循环与可选的秩为k的非线性创新项的组合，同时保留非线性观测编码器和动作头。在五个匹配的随机种子上，纯线性循环模型（k=0）在测试的整个跟踪丢失范围内都与GRU基线和教师策略表现相当，而增加非线性创新项的秩并未带来可测量的收益。该结果是在一个全新的测试集上获得的，该测试集只有在所有模型和分析都冻结之后才会开放。
tldr: 该研究发现，在需要记忆的机器人空气曲棍球防守任务中，仅需64维的纯线性循环记忆即可蒸馏DreamerV3世界模型教师策略，其表现与GRU基线及教师策略相当，而加入非线性创新项并无额外收益。
en_tdlr: A compact 64-dimensional purely linear recurrent policy suffices to distil a DreamerV3 world-model teacher for memory-dependent robot air hockey defence, matching GRU baselines under tracking loss while adding nonlinear innovation provides no measurable benefit.
